chunk_size.description: Data requests end on a multiple of this (except the last).

complete.description: All bytes arrived and the upload is finalized.

expires_at.description: When the unattached upload expires (24 h).

upload_id.description: The upload id (= the future attachment id).

upload_url.description: The signed data URL: `POST` chunks, `GET` the committed offset. No Bearer.

url_expires_at.description: When `upload_url` stops working (55–60 min); `GET /uploads/{id}` issues a fresh one.
